scope: String array fields in synchronous recursive CPU records and enums

implementation.admission: Recursive fields admit rank-one String arrays, with independent frontend and backend subset checks
implementation.ownership: Checked private String-array bridge validates descriptors and elements, then publishes a managed owner retaining array storage and each nonempty character buffer; parent boxing retains that owner
implementation.duplicates: Repeated String buffers retain independent edges per element; empty Strings contribute none
implementation.inactive: Inactive array fields are neither inspected nor allocated; canonical empty arrays need no owner
implementation.failure: Bounded temporary dependency table is released on success, fault and cancellation; recursive owner construction retains dependencies transactionally
implementation.copying: Array elements and character buffers are not copied during boxing; the owner copies only the small array descriptor
implementation.separation: Record/enum collections, callable fields, application-error channels, workers, GPU and public bridge exports remain outside recursive admission

coverage: Returned recursive nodes and escaping String arrays
Shared tails and shared/duplicate String backing
Unicode, embedded NULs, empty arrays and empty elements
Array slicing/concatenation results and inactive allocation avoidance
Bounds faults and allocation failure through source construction
Generated inline-wrapper boxing retains array and String bytes after invocation settlement
Final release drops descriptor and every duplicate String buffer edge
Invalid bases, lengths, offsets, strides and foreign/invalid element descriptors rejected before publication
Allocation failure at terminal, temporary table, dependency owner and parent publication
Cancelled entry, invalid active flags and null active descriptor rejected
Maximum accepted and first rejected private dependency counts
Existing recursive and nonrecursive ownership regressions
qualification.format: Changed C++ ranges formatted; new/changed tests pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes

limitations: Private owner limit is 300000 dependencies including one array descriptor backing; excess nonempty element references produce AllocationFault
Temporary pointer table and owner are separate allocations; compacting allocations and duplicate edges remains optimization work
Record/enum collections and callable fields remain rejected in recursive units
Recursive worker/parallel/continuation execution, application-error channels, placement/GPU and CPU bridge exports remain rejected
Existing call/stack and allocation limits remain unchanged
